subject: Coordinating multi-prospect technical office hours — confirm host zones & fallback

Cc: soojin_lee@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com

Subject: Multi-prospect technical office hours — proposed times & quick agenda

Hi Anna, team at HealthLytics and Finera,

Thanks for the quick intros today. We'd like to run a group technical office hours to cover: integration patterns for the Redwood inference runtime, model routing/cost tradeoffs, and a short Q&A on private deployment options. The goal is a focused 45-minute session with breakout time for each company’s specific integration questions.

Proposed slots (pick your preference):
- Tue Nov 30, 2026 — 11:00 AM PT / 2:00 PM ET (best for NA east/west overlap)
- Tue Nov 30, 2026 — 4:00 PM UTC / 11:00 AM PT (better for EU overlap)

Ask: please reply with the slot that works for you and list 1–2 priority topics (e.g., streaming latency, VPC setup, KV caching). I’m cc’ing Soojin and Ben to handle host/facilitation and breakout rooms.

Attached: office-hours-agenda.pdf (draft) — we can tweak topics based on responses. I’ll send a consolidated calendar invite once we lock the slot and add a backup fallback time if we need to split for timezones.

Thanks,
Karthik

Redwood Inference
From: Anna Morales <anna@dataforge.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 17:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Multi-prospect technical office hours — proposed times & quick agenda

Hi Karthik — thanks for organizing.

DataForge would love to join but the 11:00 AM PT slot on Nov 30 overlaps with our weekly on-call rotation. We can make the 4:00 PM UTC option work in theory, but our engineering lead can only join between 12:00–1:00 PM PT (19:00–20:00 UTC).

Priority topics from our side:
- VPC/firewall rules for private deployment
- Prefix/KV caching behavior for high-throughput APIs

If possible, could you either: 1) confirm a narrower 12:00 PM PT slot on Nov 30 for a shorter 30-minute deep-dive with DataForge, or 2) keep them in the later session but plan a quick 1:1 follow-up?

—Anna
Anna Morales
Head of Integrations, DataForge

Karthik / Ben — quick internal note before I reply to the three prospects:

- If Anna needs the 12:00 PM PT deep-dive, we can offer a 30-minute focused slot (12:00–12:30 PT) for DataForge and then run the group session at 11:00 PT only for HealthLytics/Finera, but that fragments the cohort.
- Alternative: keep the 11:00 PT group session (preferred for overall attendance) and schedule a 1:1 follow-up for DataForge at 12:00 PT the same day (SLA: 30 min). I can host the 1:1; Ben can handle breakout facilitation for the main group.
- Laura — would you be able to join either as infra backup for VPN/KMS questions (leaning 11:00 PT group + 12:00 PT 1:1)? If yes, I’ll confirm with prospects.

If we do the 1:1 fallback, we should:
- Send a single calendar invite per company with the appropriate session in the title (e.g., \"Redwood Office Hours — DataForge (12:00 PT 30min)\").
- Add a HubSpot note linking to the HubSpot record (HS-Record-45293) and attach the short deep-dive slide deck.

Thanks — can confirm once I hear from Laura.

—Soojin
